changeSet.author: devops
changeSet.comment: Create campaign table (1:1 shared PK with player_character)
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE campaign ( character_id BIGINT NOT NULL, narrative_summary TEXT, summary_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, turn_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_summary_at_turn INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, current_location TEXT, game_date TEXT, game_time TEXT, meteo TEXT, temperature TEXT, created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT pk_campaign PRIMARY KEY (character_id), CONSTRAINT fk_campaign_player_character FOREIGN KEY (character_id) REFERENCES player_character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

changeSet.author: devops
changeSet.comment: Create adventure_log table for chronological game history
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE adventure_log ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, turn_number INT NOT NULL, created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT pk_adventure_log PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_adventure_log_campaign FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaign (character_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX idx_adventure_log_campaign_turn ON adventure_log (campaign_id, turn_number);

changeSet.author: devops
changeSet.comment: Create player_inventory table for versioned JSONB inventory snapshots
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE player_inventory ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, turn_number INT NOT NULL, inventory JSONB NOT NULL, created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT pk_player_inventory PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_player_inventory_campaign FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaign (character_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX idx_player_inventory_campaign_version ON player_inventory (campaign_id, version);

changeSet.author: devops
changeSet.comment: Create campaign_questlog table for markdown quest snapshots
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE campaign_questlog ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL, turn_number INT NOT NULL, quest_active TEXT, quest_completed TEXT, created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT pk_campaign_questlog PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_campaign_questlog_campaign FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaign (character_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_questlog_campaign_turn ON campaign_questlog (campaign_id, turn_number);
